The Fairly OddParents (2001)

The zany, fast-paced adventures of a 10-year-old boy and his fairy godparents, who inadvertently create havoc as they grant wishes for their pint-sized charge.

Key facts

  • First air date: 30 March 2001
  • Seasons: 10 · Episodes: 268
  • Created by: Butch Hartman
  • Genres: Animation, Comedy, Sci-Fi & Fantasy, Kids
  • TMDB rating: 7.6/10 (1163 votes)
  • Status: Ended

Top cast

  • Tara Strong as Timmy Turner / Poof (voice)
  • Susanne Blakeslee as Wanda / Mrs. Turner (voice)
  • Daran Norris as Cosmo / Mr. Turner (voice)
  • Carlos Alazraqui as Denzel Q. Crocker (voice)
  • Jim Ward as Chet Ubetcha (voice)
  • Gary LeRoi Gray as A.J. (voice)
  • Grey DeLisle as Vicky (voice)
